name: [FEAT] Payments foundation (Sprint 11)
desc:
# Objective
Add a payment foundation so every placed order has a persisted, auditable payment record linked to the order. Sprint 11 keeps pay on delivery as the only customer-facing method and does not process real online payments.

# Scope
Add a payments table, update create_order to insert payments atomically, extend checkout domain/data mapping, show payment status in checkout success UI, add ARB copy, and validate RLS/guards/tests.

# Acceptance Criteria
Every order creates exactly one payment row atomically; payment data is RLS-protected; payment concepts stay in pure-Dart domain types; Supabase details stay in data layers; UI uses ARB copy and theme tokens; no gateway secrets or real card processing are introduced.

# Dependencies
Sprint 10 checkout persistence, orders/order_items schema, create_order RPC, ARB pipeline, Theme Guard, remote Supabase project access.

# Technical Notes
Use SECURITY INVOKER for create_order, keep Flutter free of payment provider secrets, and treat future Stripe/webhook work as a separate gateway slice.

checkItems.name: Add payments table linked 1:1 with orders
Update create_order RPC to insert orders, order_items, and payments atomically
Extend checkout domain models with payment method/status/value objects
Extend DTO and repository mapping so PlacedOrder includes payment summary
Update checkout UI and success state to show payment status
Keep cash_on_delivery as the only selectable method
Every new order creates exactly one linked payment row in the same transaction as orders and order_items
payments has RLS enabled, explicit grants, anon denial, and cross-user read isolation
Payment concepts are represented by pure-Dart domain types
Supabase RPC and data details stay inside datasource and repository layers
PlacedOrder includes a payment summary mapped from the RPC response
Checkout success UI shows payment status using ARB copy
No real card, gateway, or secret handling is introduced in Flutter
Sprint 10 checkout persistence and create_order RPC are available
Existing orders and order_items RLS/grants discipline is preserved
ARB pipeline and generated localization freshness guard are available
Theme Guard and app design tokens are available
Remote Supabase project access is available for migration validation

UI reads strings through `AppLocalizations`
No hardcoded copy in `Text`, `SnackBar`, `Tooltip`, `AlertDialog`, `BottomSheet`, `showModalBottomSheet`, or `semanticLabel`
ARB catalog parity guard remains green after copy changes

Authenticated order creation creates the payment row atomically
anon denial and cross-user payment read isolation are verified

Localization and Theme Guard tests remain green

Docs, memory, technical debt, and real Trello parity are reconciled after validation evidence exists
